description: Gold extraction set for the Fact Knowledge Layer starter corpus (6 PDFs). Every item was hand-verified against the source PDF text during Week 2 Phase 0/1. Items marked source=current_pipeline are unique true claims present in the Week 1 clean baseline run (13 raw rows, verified and deduplicated by hand). Items marked source=recall_miss are extractable claims found by manual reading that the pipeline currently does NOT surface — they exist so evaluation measures recall, not just precision. Week 3 Phase 0 (gold_version week3-phase0): revised for the macro-indicator (Cluster G) pattern blast radius — a corpus-wide scan of all candidate pages found 3 additional source-verified claims (ex-022..ex-024) beyond the original four, and ex-020's period was corrected to the source wording. The week2-frozen snapshot in results.json predates this revision and remains the immutable Week 2 baseline.
match_notes: Matching normalizes whitespace (strip/collapse, casefold) and stringifies numeric values. as_of is part of the key so status claims differing only by effective date (two distinct cessation sentences for one director) stay distinct, while evidence page is NOT part of the key — page-level repetition of an identical claim is exactly what Defect A duplicates look like. period and scope are recorded as source truth and reported as secondary capture metrics (period_capture, scope_capture); they are not part of the primary match key because the Week 1 extractor does not consistently populate them and Week 2 scope work (L1) is scored via scope_capture and the relationship gold set.
